author: Zegita
body:
I know I'm not going to get unbanned seeing as it is temp but you know worth having a shot at least.

I sincerely apologise for my behaviour with Rememes and how I was acting with him I know that it violated the rules of Avicus by swearing and being "rude" to him but it was all a joke. We are good friends and we both take no offense and we were both laughing anyways when we were messaging (it's true).

I also 100% apologise for my behaviour in chat when I said "./t you nigs and F U cock". Obviously this is not acceptable and I 100% understand this and this is really my fault for chatting in the chat. I just got a bit ahead of myself and was really hyper. However, this is no excuse for my actions and once again I am really sorry.

I respect the decisions you make whether or not you will unban me but in all honesty I know I won't be unbanned. Anyway thank you for taking your time and dedication for reading this appeal

Yours sincerely

|Zegita|

title: Racism and Rudeness Appeal

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I'm going to decline this appeal since you have had 15 chances alone to not break the rules in chat. Out of all these chances, you have not shown improvement, including the 2-3 times I have talked to you personally.

What's worse over you being banned again, is that you broke a pact that you would behave better. You apologized, and took responsibility for your actions. With this in mind, and now you creating this appeal, I do not take it lightly.

When you're on an Avicus service, regardless of what you say, you have to realize that everything you say will have an effect. In this case, the effect is bad, and the jokes were not necessary to say. And, even if the player in question isn't offended, even more it's the principle that you behave poorly. We want to correct your behavior, not punish you, and we're doing this for a reason.

As well as this, you realize that this isn't a good choice either, because you actually have gotten 15 infractions within the past 8 months, warranting a month ban based off of our guidelines. Please consider these factors, and try not to do it again.
